g.title: HR_OTHERSTRUCTASSIGNMENT
g.text: Other Structure Assignment - Is a deployment of a employee in a Structure which is an alternative to the Organizational Structure. Used for example, to represent Deployment by Project or Deployment in Simulated Structures.
The Identifier of the Company Relationship record.
The Identifier of the Structure record.
The validity start date for an historical situation.
The validity end date for an historical situation.
This flag indicates if the assignment is primary or not.
The Identifier of the Change Reason record.
The Identifier of the OrgUnit record.
The Identifier of the Position record.
The percentage of an FTE (Full Time Equivalent).
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: HR_COMPANYRELATIONSHIP
g.text: Company Relationship - Provides key information about an employment contract associated with a staffing assignment or staffing resource.
The Identifier of the Person record.
The identifier of the Worker Type record.
Specifies the last company assigned to the company relationship.
The Identifier of the Work Agency record.
Identifier of the Worker. Depending on the type of data representation, it could be the same as the Contract Id or an Employee Number which can stay fixed while the contract number changes.
This flag indicates if the assignment is primary or not.
The Identifier of the Start Reason record.
The Identifier of the End Reason record.
The date on which the associated person was hired. Some contexts and situations may require fine-grain distinctions. See Original Hire Date, Duty Entry Date.

A hire date that has been modified for a particular reason. Typically, this would not be the actual date of hire, but the date on which the person is treated as having been hired for pay or benefits purposes.
The Group Seniority Date is the start date of the first contract of a person regardless of the company within the group.
The Company Seniority Date is usually calculated from the start date of the first company assignment in that company.
The length of the Probation Period, expressed in a specific Time Unit (weeks, days, etc.).
Time Unit the probation period is expressed with.
The End Date of the Probation Period. Normally calculated from the Start Date of the Contract plus the Probation Period Length.
The length of the notice period, expressed in a specific time unit.
Time Unit the notice period is expressed with.
The date the Person gives notice to the company that they are leaving.
The End Date of the notice period. It is normally calculated as the Notice given date plus the length of the notice period.
The length of the Relationship Period, expressed in a specific Time Unit (weeks, days etc.).
Time Unit the Contract duration is expressed with.
This is the date the contract is expected to end.
The identifier of the Job Offer record.
The Identifier of the Protected Category record.
The amount of Taxable Pay from the previous employer.
The Tax Paid during the Previous Employment.
The date on which a person completes the necessary paperwork and is sworn in as an employee.
The amount of Taxable Pay from their previous employmer, in the system currency.
It's the Tax Paid in the Previous Employment expressed in system currency.
This field contains the seniority date for the line of business
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation

Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: HR_ORGUNIT
g.text: Organizational Unit - Organizational units are functional units in an Group. They can cross several Legal entities (Companies) and are normally designed around specific Functions or Types of Activities.
The validity start date for an historical situation.
The validity end date for an historical situation.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it

g.title: HR_POSITION
g.text: Position - A single or specific instance of a job in the context of an Organizational Structure.

The Name of an Organizational Position. An Organizational Position is a Job in a specific Unit, thus identifying beyond a specific set of responsibilities, goals and Competencies, where the Job is excercised in the Structure and who the Person in the Job reports to.
The validity start date for an historical situation.
The validity end date for an historical situation.

Flag indicating that the position is managerial. A person covering a Managerial position is, by default, the hierarchical manager of all persons deployed in the same Organizational Unit and of all the Managers of the Units below.
This flag indicates if the position is a staff position.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation
